title: Wohin kommt der Karton
desc: Answering the question that was asked
setting: An office kitchen in September, a colleague three weeks into the country, and forty minutes you could easily take.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Weisst du, wohin der Karton kommt?
steps.en: Do you know where the cardboard goes?

options.es: Gebündelt an die Strasse, am Mittwoch.
options.en: Bundled, out on the street, on Wednesday.
options.feedback: Two facts and a day. That is the answer to the question she asked.

options.es: Oh, das ist eine lange Geschichte.
options.en: Oh, that is a long story.
options.feedback: It is not. It is one sentence, and she has to do it tomorrow.

options.es: Bei mir war das am Anfang das Schlimmste.
options.en: That was the worst thing for me at the beginning.
options.feedback: True and it is your story. Answer first, tell it later if she asks.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Und der Rest? Da ist so viel.
steps.en: And the rest? There is so much of it.

options.es: Vier Sachen. Sack, Karton, Glas, Alu.
options.en: Four things. Bag, cardboard, glass, aluminium.
options.feedback: Four boxes, four words. The exceptions can wait for the second year.

options.es: Papier und Karton sind übrigens verschiedene Tage.
options.en: Paper and cardboard are different days, by the way.
options.feedback: True, and it is exception number one before she has the rule.

options.es: Das lernst du mit der Zeit.
options.en: You will learn that in time.
options.feedback: She asked now, because the bag is in her hall now.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Und wenn ich es falsch mache?
steps.en: And what if I do it wrong?

options.en: Then somebody says something to you.
options.feedback: The honest answer, and the next sentence is what makes it bearable.
It happens and it is rare. What actually happens is a neighbour.
Something does happen and she will be blindsided by it. She would rather know.

steps.speaker: Anna
steps.es: Kann ich dich fragen, wenn ich etwas nicht weiss?
steps.en: Can I ask you if I do not know something?

options.feedback: Two words. Anything longer turns a small offer into an obligation for her.

options.es: Ja, aber frag ruhig auch die Nachbarn.
options.en: Yes, but do ask the neighbours too.
options.feedback: Good advice in four months. Today she is asking whether she is allowed to ask you.

options.es: Ich schicke dir alles per Mail.
options.en: I will send you everything by email.
options.feedback: She asked for a person, not a document.
